afterClose.zh-CN: 菜单关闭且离场动画结束后调用。
afterClose.en-US: Called after the menu has closed and its leave animation has ended.

afterOpen.zh-CN: 菜单打开且进场动画结束后调用；没有进场动画时打开后即调用；进场结束前被关闭的打开不调用。
afterOpen.en-US: Called after the menu has opened and its enter animation has ended, or right after opening when there is no enter animation. An opening closed before the enter animation ends does not call it.

arrowPointAtCenter.zh-CN: 箭头是否指向触发元素的中心，只在 `showArrow` 为 `true` 时生效，默认 `true`。
arrowPointAtCenter.en-US: Whether the arrow points at the center of the trigger. Takes effect only when `showArrow` is `true`. Defaults to `true`.

aria-label.zh-CN: 弹出层 `role` 为 `dialog` 时的 `aria-label`。
aria-label.en-US: `aria-label` of the popup when its `role` is `dialog`.

aria-labelledby.zh-CN: 弹出层 `role` 为 `dialog` 时的 `aria-labelledby`。
aria-labelledby.en-US: `aria-labelledby` of the popup when its `role` is `dialog`.

autoAdjustOverflow.zh-CN: 弹出层被遮挡时是否自动调整方向，默认 `true`。
autoAdjustOverflow.en-US: Whether the menu flips to another side when it would be clipped. Defaults to `true`.

children.zh-CN: 触发元素。传入单个元素时由它接收触发事件与 ARIA 属性；文本或多个节点由 `span` 包裹后作为触发元素。
children.en-US: The trigger. A single element receives the trigger events and ARIA attributes; text or several nodes are wrapped in a `span`.

className.zh-CN: 弹出层外层 `.semi-dropdown-wrapper` 的类名。
className.en-US: Class name of the popup's outer `.semi-dropdown-wrapper` element.

clickToHide.zh-CN: 在弹出层内点击时是否自动关闭弹出层，默认 `false`。
clickToHide.en-US: Whether a click inside the popup closes it. Defaults to `false`.

clickTriggerToHide.zh-CN: 点击触发元素时是否关闭已打开的菜单。
clickTriggerToHide.en-US: Whether a click on the trigger closes an open menu.

closeOnEsc.zh-CN: 在触发元素或弹出层按 Esc 是否关闭菜单。`trigger` 为 `custom` 时只调用 `onEscKeyDown`，由使用方决定是否关闭。
closeOnEsc.en-US: Whether Esc on the trigger or in the popup closes the menu. With `trigger` `custom` it only calls `onEscKeyDown`, and the caller decides whether to close.

condition.zh-CN: 是否允许触发显示，默认 `true`；仅显式设为 `false` 时，hover、click、focus 等触发行为不生效，`trigger` 为 `custom` 时仍按 `visible` 显示。由 `true` 变为 `false` 时立即关闭已显示的菜单。
condition.en-US: Whether the trigger may show the menu. Defaults to `true`. Only an explicit `false` disables the hover, click and focus triggers; with `trigger` `custom`, `visible` still shows the menu. Changing it from `true` to `false` closes an open menu at once.

content.zh-CN: 由 Dropdown 固定为菜单内容，传入的值无效；菜单内容请使用 `render` 或 `menu`。
content.en-US: Dropdown sets this to the menu content, so a value passed here has no effect. Use `render` or `menu` for the content.

contentClassName.zh-CN: 下拉菜单容器 `.semi-dropdown` 的类名。
contentClassName.en-US: Class name of the menu container `.semi-dropdown`.

disableArrowKeyDown.zh-CN: 由 Dropdown 固定为 `true`，方向键由 Dropdown 自行处理，传入的值无效。
disableArrowKeyDown.en-US: Dropdown always sets this to `true` and handles the arrow keys itself, so a value passed here has no effect.

disableFocusListener.zh-CN: `trigger` 为 `hover` 时，是否不响应键盘聚焦打开菜单，默认 `false`。
disableFocusListener.en-US: Whether keyboard focus is ignored when `trigger` is `hover`. Defaults to `false`.

guardFocus.zh-CN: 焦点位于弹出层内时，Tab 是否在弹出层内循环，默认 `false`。
guardFocus.en-US: Whether Tab cycles inside the popup while focus is in it. Defaults to `false`.

keepDOM.zh-CN: 关闭时是否保留菜单的 DOM 而不销毁，默认 `false`。
keepDOM.en-US: Whether the menu's DOM is kept instead of destroyed when it closes. Defaults to `false`.

menu.zh-CN: 通过数据快速配置菜单，数据项为 `node` 为 `item`、`title` 或 `divider` 的对象，见下方 DropdownMenuItem；提供 `render` 时以 `render` 为准。
menu.en-US: Configures the menu from data: objects whose `node` is `item`, `title` or `divider`, see DropdownMenuItem below. `render` takes precedence when it is provided.

mouseEnterDelay.zh-CN: 指针移入触发元素后延迟显示的毫秒数，默认 `50`，仅 `trigger` 为 `hover` 或 `focus` 时生效。
mouseEnterDelay.en-US: Milliseconds before the menu shows after the pointer enters the trigger. Defaults to `50`. Applies to the `hover` and `focus` triggers.

mouseLeaveDelay.zh-CN: 指针移出弹出层后延迟隐藏的毫秒数，仅 `trigger` 为 `hover` 或 `focus` 时生效。
mouseLeaveDelay.en-US: Milliseconds before the menu hides after the pointer leaves the popup. Applies to the `hover` and `focus` triggers.

motion.zh-CN: 是否展示弹出层的进出场动画。
motion.en-US: Whether the popup plays its enter and leave animations.

onClickOutSide.zh-CN: 按下触发元素与弹出层以外的区域时调用，参数是原生 `MouseEvent`。仅 `trigger` 为 `click`、`contextMenu`、`custom` 或开启 `clickTriggerToHide` 时生效。
onClickOutSide.en-US: Called when the mouse is pressed outside the trigger and the popup, with the native `MouseEvent`. Takes effect only for `trigger` `click`, `contextMenu` or `custom`, or with `clickTriggerToHide`.

onEscKeyDown.zh-CN: 菜单打开期间按 Esc 时调用，参数是原生 `KeyboardEvent`。
onEscKeyDown.en-US: Called when Esc is pressed while the menu is open, with the native `KeyboardEvent`.

onOpen.zh-CN: 菜单显示、进场动画开始时调用，每次打开调用一次，早于 `afterOpen`；悬停打开后指针已离开而撤回的打开不调用。
onOpen.en-US: Called once per opening when the menu is shown and its enter animation starts, before `afterOpen`. An opening withdrawn because the pointer already left does not call it.

onVisibleChange.zh-CN: 菜单显示状态变化时调用，参数为 `visible`。`visible` 受控时只报告用户交互发起的请求，使用方自己改变 `visible` 不调用。
onVisibleChange.en-US: Called with `visible` when the visibility of the menu changes. With a controlled `visible` it reports only requests from user interaction, not changes the caller makes to `visible`.

position.zh-CN: 弹出菜单相对触发元素的位置，常用 `bottom`、`bottomLeft`、`bottomRight`，更多见 Tooltip 的位置。
position.en-US: Position of the menu relative to the trigger. Common values are `bottom`, `bottomLeft` and `bottomRight`. See the Tooltip positions for more.

preventScroll.zh-CN: 聚焦时是否阻止浏览器滚动到被聚焦元素，默认 `false`。
preventScroll.en-US: Whether focusing an element avoids scrolling it into view. Defaults to `false`.

ref.en-US: Receives the `DropdownHandle` when mounted, and `null` when unmounted.

render.zh-CN: 弹出层的内容，由 `Dropdown.Menu` 及 `Dropdown.Item`、`Dropdown.Title`、`Dropdown.Divider` 构成。传入时优先于 `menu`。
render.en-US: Content of the popup, made of `Dropdown.Menu` with `Dropdown.Item`, `Dropdown.Title` and `Dropdown.Divider`. It takes precedence over `menu` when provided.

returnFocusOnClose.zh-CN: 菜单关闭后焦点是否回到触发元素，默认 `true`。
returnFocusOnClose.en-US: Whether focus returns to the trigger after the menu closes. Defaults to `true`.

role.zh-CN: 包裹菜单的弹层容器的 ARIA role，默认 `presentation`；菜单本身的 role 为 `menu`。
role.en-US: ARIA role of the popup container around the menu, `presentation` by default. The menu itself has role `menu`.

selectionMode.zh-CN: 本层菜单项的选择方式，已选项由 `active` 标记：`single` 时菜单项为带 `aria-checked` 的 `menuitemradio`，`multiple` 时为带 `aria-checked` 的 `menuitemcheckbox`；未设置时 `showTick` 开启则为带 `aria-checked` 的 `menuitemcheckbox`，否则为 `menuitem`。只影响角色与状态，勾的显示仍由 `showTick` 决定；嵌套的子菜单不继承。
selectionMode.en-US: How the items of this menu are selected; `active` marks the selected ones. With `single` the items are `menuitemradio` with `aria-checked`, with `multiple` `menuitemcheckbox` with `aria-checked`; unset, they are `menuitemcheckbox` with `aria-checked` when `showTick` is on, otherwise `menuitem`. It sets roles and states only: `showTick` alone shows the tick. Nested submenus do not inherit it.

showArrow.en-US: Whether the arrow is shown. Defaults to `false`.

showTick.zh-CN: 是否在 `active` 的 `Dropdown.Item` 左侧展示表示选中的勾；只作用于本 Dropdown 的菜单，嵌套的子菜单不继承。
showTick.en-US: Whether an active `Dropdown.Item` shows a tick on its leading side. It applies to the menu of this Dropdown only; nested submenus do not inherit it.

spacing.zh-CN: 弹出层与触发元素的距离，单位为像素；缺省时顶层菜单为 `4`，嵌套的子菜单为 `2`。
spacing.en-US: Distance in pixels between the popup and the trigger. Defaults to `4` for a top-level menu and `2` for a nested submenu.

stopPropagation.zh-CN: 是否阻止弹出层上的 click、mousedown 与焦点进出事件冒泡，默认 `false`。
stopPropagation.en-US: Whether click, mousedown and focus in/out events on the popup stop propagating. Defaults to `false`.

style.zh-CN: 下拉菜单容器 `.semi-dropdown` 的内联样式。
style.en-US: Inline style of the menu container `.semi-dropdown`.

trigger.zh-CN: 触发菜单显示的行为，可选 `hover`、`focus`、`click`、`custom`、`contextMenu`；`custom` 时显示与否完全由 `visible` 决定。
trigger.en-US: What shows the menu: `hover`, `focus`, `click`, `custom` or `contextMenu`. With `custom`, `visible` alone decides.

visible.zh-CN: 菜单是否显示。配合 `trigger` 为 `custom` 使用；传入后由该值决定显示，触发器、点击外部与 Esc 只通过 `onVisibleChange` 请求打开或关闭。
visible.en-US: Whether the menu is shown. Used with `trigger` `custom`. When given, this value decides, and the trigger, a click outside and Esc only request a change through `onVisibleChange`.

wrapperClassName.zh-CN: 触发元素被 `span` 包裹时，该 `span` 的类名。
wrapperClassName.en-US: Class name of the `span` that wraps the trigger when a wrapper is needed.

wrapperId.zh-CN: 弹出层节点的 id，触发元素的 ARIA 属性指向它；缺省时自动生成。
wrapperId.en-US: id of the popup element, referenced by the trigger's ARIA attributes. Generated when omitted.

wrapWhenSpecial.zh-CN: 触发元素为禁用或加载中的 Button 等特殊触发器时，是否在外层包裹 `span` 以保证触发行为，默认 `true`。
wrapWhenSpecial.en-US: Whether a special trigger, such as a disabled or loading Button, is wrapped in a `span` so that it still triggers the menu. Defaults to `true`.

focusTrigger.zh-CN: 让触发元素获得焦点，仅在 `returnFocusOnClose` 为 `true` 且 `trigger` 不是 `custom` 时生效。
focusTrigger.en-US: Focuses the trigger element. Takes effect only when `returnFocusOnClose` is `true` and `trigger` is not `custom`.

rePosition.zh-CN: 按触发器当前位置立即重新计算弹出层位置。弹出层已随滚动、窗口尺寸变化、触发器移动以及触发器或弹出层的尺寸变化自动重新定位，一般无需调用；跟随触发器移动会晚一帧，需要同一帧内对齐时调用。
rePosition.en-US: Recomputes the popup position from the trigger's current position at once. The popup already follows scrolling, window resizing, trigger moves and size changes of the trigger or popup, so this is rarely needed; following a trigger move lands a frame late, so call this to align within the same frame.

children.zh-CN: 菜单的子元素，一般为 `Dropdown.Item` 或 `Dropdown.Title`。
children.en-US: Children of the menu, usually `Dropdown.Item` or `Dropdown.Title`.

className.en-US: Class name of the menu `ul` element.

style.zh-CN: 菜单 `ul` 元素的内联样式。
style.en-US: Inline style of the menu `ul` element.

active.zh-CN: 当前项是否处于激活态，激活态时字体加粗、颜色加深；展示勾时（`showTick` 为 `true`）左侧还会展示 √。
active.en-US: Whether the item is active: bolder text and a deeper color, plus a tick on its leading side when the tick is shown.

children.zh-CN: 菜单项的内容，渲染在图标之后。
children.en-US: Content of the item, rendered after the icon.

className.en-US: Class name of the root `li` element.

disabled.zh-CN: 是否禁用该项；禁用项不响应点击与鼠标事件，并带 `aria-disabled` 为 `true`。
disabled.en-US: Whether the item is disabled. A disabled item does not respond to clicks or mouse events and has `aria-disabled` `true`.

forwardRef.zh-CN: 根 `li` 元素挂载时以该元素调用，供包装 `Dropdown.Item` 的组件获取元素。
forwardRef.en-US: Called with the root `li` element when it mounts, for a component that wraps `Dropdown.Item` and needs the element.

icon.zh-CN: 菜单项的图标，渲染在内容之前。
icon.en-US: Icon of the item, rendered before the content.

onClick.zh-CN: 单击时调用，参数为 `MouseEvent`；位于嵌套子菜单内的项在鼠标左键按下时调用，键盘激活时也调用；禁用项不调用。
onClick.en-US: Called on click with the `MouseEvent`. For an item inside a nested submenu it is called on the left mouse press, and on keyboard activation. Not called for a disabled item.

onContextMenu.zh-CN: 右键点击时调用。禁用项不调用。
onContextMenu.en-US: Called on a right click. Not called for a disabled item.

onMouseEnter.zh-CN: 指针移入时调用。禁用项不调用。
onMouseEnter.en-US: Called when the pointer enters the item. Not called for a disabled item.

onMouseLeave.zh-CN: 指针移出时调用。禁用项不调用。
onMouseLeave.en-US: Called when the pointer leaves the item. Not called for a disabled item.

showTick.zh-CN: 仅在 Dropdown 之外使用时生效；在 Dropdown 内以 Dropdown 的 `showTick` 为准。
showTick.en-US: Takes effect only outside a Dropdown. Inside one, the `showTick` of the Dropdown applies.

style.zh-CN: 根 `li` 元素的内联样式。
style.en-US: Inline style of the root `li` element.

children.en-US: Text or content of the title.

className.en-US: Class name of the root `li` element.

style.zh-CN: 根 `li` 元素的内联样式。
style.en-US: Inline style of the root `li` element.
